p: multitude that was among them fell: Which were of those strangers that came out of Egypt with them, Ex 12:38.
freely: For a final price, or good cheap.
dried away: For the greedy lust of flesh.
bdellium: Which is a white pearl, or precious stone.
favour in thy sight: Or, how have I displeased you?
conceived all this people: Am I their father, that no one may have charge of them but I?
land which thou swarest unto their: Of Canaan promised by another to our fathers.
sight: I would rather die than see my grief and misery daily increased by their rebellion.
and I will take of the: I will distribute my spirit among them, as I have done to you.
Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: Prepare yourselves that you may be clean.
despised the LORD which is: Or, cast him off, because you refused manna, which he appointed as most suitable for you.
among you: Who leads and governs you.
among whom I am: Of whom I have charge.
cease: From that day the spirit of prophecy did not settle them.
young men: Or, a young man whom he had chosen from his youth.
forbid them: Such blind zeal was in the apostles, Mr 9:38, Lu 9:44.
homers: Of Homer, read Le 27:16 also it signifies a heap, as in Ex 8:14; Jud 15:16.
